name: Pillar Shield
description: Blocking raises a tall pillar under you with its own shield.
details:
Blocking raises a tall, wide pillar under you, boxed in by a square shield that lines up with the pillar's walls. The shield starts at 170 health; Block size makes it (and the pillar) bigger and tougher, and Block duration adds more health.

The shield belongs to the pillar, not to you: it protects whoever stands on top from your enemies until it's shot down. Step off and you're on your own. Blocking again moves the pillar to where you are.
